title.purpose: Service names, sign arms, card and trail titles.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Yellow board-coloured primary action with ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: #f2c230; color: #151a16; padding: 13px 26px; border-radius: 4px; font: 600 16px/1.4 Barlow, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f6d462; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151a16; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-block; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55); color: #fff; padding: 11.5px 25px; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 16px/1.4 Barlow, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .2s ease, background-color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2c230; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sign Board (arm)
components.description: Yellow arrow board with ink rules; right-pointing arm.
components.css: .ds-arm { background: #f2c230; color: #151a16; padding: 11px 42px 11px 20px; width: 280px; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 #151a16, inset 0 -2px 0 #151a16; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 22px) 0, 100% 50%, calc(100% - 22px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-arm b { display: block; font: 700 28px/1.05 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .01em; } .ds-arm span { display: block; font: 500 15px/1.3 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Service List Row
components.description: Ink-ruled service row with condensed name and arrow.
components.html: • WebdesignIhre Website, persönlich umgesetzt.
components.css: .ds-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-list li { border-top: 2px solid #151a16; border-bottom: 2px solid #151a16; } .ds-list a { display: block; padding: 26px 56px 26px 0; color: #151a16; text-decoration: none; transition: padding .25s ease; } .ds-list a:hover { padding-left: 14px; } .ds-name { display: block; font: 700 40px/1.05 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-text { display: block; color: #46504a; font: 400 17px/1.6 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 36px; background: #f3f6f2; padding: 20px 24px; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; color: #46504a; font: 500 16px Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; padding: 6px 0; text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a.active { color: #151a16; } .ds-nav a.active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 3px; background: #f2c230; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1e3a2f; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a Schwarzwald-Baar hiking signpost: it points a local business owner to the next step. Flat Tannengrün grounds carry Wegweiser-Gelb arrow boards lettered in black ink; Kalkstein sections give the reading rhythm in between. The world stays recognisable with all content removed: yellow arrow boards on a green field.

The tone is calm and precise. Sign lettering is condensed, uppercase where it is a sign, and reading text is plain Barlow. Every board is flat, with one pointed end and a thin ink rule top and bottom; depth comes from colour blocks, not effects. A person and a place come before decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Fir-green ground, yellow signal boards, limestone reading sections, warm-black ink.
Arrow-shaped boards (clip-path point) with 2–3px ink rules inside top and bottom edges.
Barlow Condensed for sign lettering and headings, Barlow for reading.
Flat at rest; motion is small fades and 6–14px slides, all disabled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Yellow appears only on boards, the primary action, and small markers (underline, dots, price). Never as a section background except the closing board.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Yellow Rule
rules.body: Text on yellow is always ink, never white or green.

rules.name: The Sign-Or-Read Rule
rules.body: Condensed face for signs and headings, Barlow for anything read in sentences. Headings use text-wrap: balance.

rules.name: The Flat-Board Rule
rules.body: Boards carry no drop shadows; their edge is the ink rule drawn as an inset shadow.

dos: Do put yellow only on arrow boards, the primary action and small markers, with ink text.
Do draw boards flat: one pointed end, 2–3px ink rules top and bottom.
Do use Barlow Condensed for headings and sign text, Barlow for sentences.
Do keep the "GDS." wordmark exactly as is (Manrope 800, indigo gradient, #7a7ae0 dot, "Webdesign & SEO" subline).
Do keep 44px minimum touch height and visible 3px focus outlines; wrap all motion in reduced-motion fallbacks.
Do use en dashes and formal German "Sie".
donts: Don't use gradient text, glow, particle or canvas effects, or navy and indigo outside the wordmark.
Don't add drop shadows to boards or cards.
Don't invent photos, references, numbers or testimonials.
Don't use typewriter or counting animations.
